items.title: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger until June 2027
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) agreed to delay its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) until June 2027 after 12 attorneys general sued to block the massive media merger.

items.title: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger amid claims of antitrust violations
items.summary: Jul. 24—OLYMPIA — The Paramount Skydance planned merger with Warner Bros. has been halted as a federal judge considers whether the deal violates antitrust laws and unfairly reduces market competition. items.title: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. Discovery takeover for months
items.summary: Paramount says its takeover of CNN’s parent company, Warner Bros. Discovery, will be delayed for many months, and potentially well into 2027, due to pending lawsuits by state attorneys general and the Writers Guild of America.

items.title: Paramount Agrees to Pause Its Warner Bros. Merger
items.summary: Paramount  said Friday it will not move forward with its merger with  Warner Bros. Discovery  until legal challenges to the deal are resolved or June 1, 2027, whichever comes first.  The concession is the latest blow to the $81 billion merger between entertainment giants Paramount and Warner, which is being challenged on antitrust grounds by 12 states and the Writers Guild of America, who argue the deal is anticompetitive.  Paramount’s decision came after a California federal court had granted a temporary restraining order stopping the deal from closing in 28 days.

items.title: PSKY Stock Ends Third Week Lower — Paramount Agrees To Pause $110B Warner Bros. Merger Amid Legal Challenges
items.summary: Paramount Skydance has formally agreed to delay its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery until at least June 2027.

items.title: Paramount to delay Warner Bros. merger until as late as June 2027
items.summary: Paramount Skydance on Friday said it would delay the deal until as late as June 2027.

items.title: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger
items.summary: Paramount Skydance agreed on Friday to delay its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros.Paramount agreed to delay the deal through June 2027, the company said in a court filing on Friday.

items.title: Paramount Skydance agrees to pause merger pending antitrust case
items.summary: Paramount Skydance agreed to postpone closing its merger with Warner Bros. Discovery until five days after a state antitrust case opposing the deal is resolved or until June 2027, when its merger agreement expires.
